DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN)

The negative bacterial culture rules out acute pyelonephritis, while the presence of leukocyturia and eosinophilic cells on cytospin strongly suggests an allergic reaction to the recent antibiotic causing kidney inflammation. Did you notice any rash or joint pain recently, and which antibiotic was prescribed for your sinusitis?
